title: Delegated template-fallback plans reach the governed delivery-injection authority — TRUE Telegram intent no longer un-plannable (BUG 4)
description: BUG 4 (R1+R2 done): delegated template plans reach the governed delivery-injection authority; producer-less delivery fails closed; injected keys unique; template declares upstream inputs. R3 — F4 (HIGH): an eligible external artifact was silently shadowed when its logical_name collided with an in-plan produce (bindPlanExternalInputs skipped self-produce consumes). Now a self-produce consume colliding with an eligible source throws FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_SHADOWED_SOURCE, and PAIR-owned ReconcileOptions.declared_external_inputs (never task metadata) mints identity-pinned consumes: logical_name verbatim when representable+uncolliding, else deterministic .pair/external/<artifact_id>.artifact alias bound by artifact_id — own output can never impersonate upstream bytes. F5 (HIGH): canonical names the instruction grammar cannot express (spaces/unicode: 'final report.md', 'báo cáo.md') or nested paths now bind via the declared channel instead of truncating/omitting; unsafe logical_names (traversal/absolute/backslash/control) fail closed at declaration. F6 (MEDIUM): eligible inputs beyond the per-task consume budget (32 incl. mission_goal.txt) reject with FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_BOUNDS — never silently truncated, global limit unchanged. mission-runtime prerequisiteMissing exempts PAIR-stamped consumes (bytes arrive via pinned CAS materialization, never local path). Tests 39/39: collision→alias bound+materialized, distinct-producer precedence kept, no-source inert, revoked/drift/unsafe→typed fail, replay byte-identical, name matrix (ASCII/nested/outbox/spaces/unicode), bound 0/1/31/32/64, plus REAL delegated-path E2E (WOB mission→COMPLETED, colliding+unicode+nested artifacts materialized byte-identical, full provenance ledger). Baseline: pair-f4 R5.1-crash fails identically on BASE cf2674c (unrelated).
